title: Private Holiday City Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy the city of Chicago during a magical time! This private experience takes you around Chicago in a private luxury vehicle with your own personal guide! Enjoy all the Holiday sites the city is known for including, Daley Plaza's Christkindl Market, Macy's Walnut Room and animated story windows, the Goodman Theatre, and marvel at the skaters under the iconic "Bean" of Millennium Park. This experience is the only way to see Chicago during the holidays!
